title: Morava K- and E-theory 1 — Show that pi_* L_K(n) S^0 is finitely generated over the p-adics in each degree.
exact_target: For every prime $p$, positive chromatic height $n\ge1$, and integer degree $k$, must $\pi_kL_{K(n)}S^0$ be a finitely generated module over the $p$-adic integers? Here $L_{K(n)}$ is localization of the sphere spectrum at the height-$n$ Morava $K$-theory.
